name: Moshimoshi?
source:
A collection of six stories told in a format of telephone talks to emphasize the meaning of everyday life events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
